thread:
ana_rust: heads up — noticed the Rust quickstart README still shows `redwood-cli run` usage and a tiny sync example that uses the old blocking API. newbies paste it and hit lifetime/borrow compile errors.

brad_sdk: ah yeah, the Rust SDK stabilized the API in v0.7 and we switched to async-first. which file?

ana_rust: examples/rust-quickstart/README.md. current snippet:```rust
let client = redwood::Client::new("sk-xxxxx");
let out = client.generate("Hello");
println!("{}", out.text);
```

ana_rust: that doesn't compile with tokio async runtime. suggest replacing with async example + env var and a note about tokio = { version = "1", features = ["macros"] } in Cargo.toml. proposed snippet:```rust
use redwood::RedwoodClient;
#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
  let client = RedwoodClient::from_env()?; // picks REDWOOD_API_KEY or cloud creds
  let resp = client.generate("Say hi to Rust").await?;
  println!("{}", resp.text);
  Ok(())
}
```

zoe_docs: nice. can you also add a short blurb about why we prefer from_env (avoid committing keys) and how to set the REDWOOD_API_KEY in mac/linux/windows? small OS examples are helpful for new devs.

ana_rust: added that in a branch and created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/441. includes README update + tiny smoke test that runs `cargo run --bin rust-quickstart` against a local mock server.

brad_sdk: two other notes: 1) the old snippet used the sync blocking client which we removed, 2) default retry behavior changed to not retry on 400-level errors — we should call that out.

zoe_docs: good call. add a one-liner: "SDK retries: exponential backoff on 429/5xx by default; set RetryPolicy to override." also add a short Troubleshooting section: "If you see borrow/Send errors, make sure you use tokio runtime and the async client."

lint-bot: docs-lint detected inline API key pattern in 3 files: examples/rust-quickstart/README.md, examples/python-quickstart/README.md, examples/cli/README.md. filing auto-fixes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/441/fixes

ana_rust: added a small check in CI (examples/ci-smoke) to run `cargo check` on example crates. CI PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/441/files changed.

infra-ci: CI started for PR #441 — running docs-lint, examples-smoke (cargo check + node/http mocks), and markdown-link-check.

brad_sdk: one more: update the CLI quickstart note. we deprecated `redwood-cli run` in favor of `redwood-cli invoke` and that caused a few support tickets. can someone search for `redwood-cli run` and replace across examples?

zoe_docs: i'll run a repo-wide grep and open a follow-up PR with replacements. adding a docs-lint rule to flag `redwood-cli run` too.

ana_rust: quick follow-up — added CONTRIBUTING.md snippet: "Run examples smoke tests locally (`make examples-smoke`) before pushing docs PRs." small but reduces copy/paste regressions.

brad_sdk: great. thanks for moving quickly. once CI passes i'll merge. this will make onboarding smoother for Rust devs.

zoe_docs: merged after tiny wording tweak. thanks all! :sparkles: if you find any other language quickstarts with sync examples, drop them here.
